Written BEFORE any read of this search; edits after the first read need the owner and are logged as a rule change.
program: pattern search B3 (path A: pattern library; path B: frequent base signal + machine-learning filter)

data.series: WIN$N back-adjusted at the rolls (b3/b3_data.py back_adjusted): features that span sessions do not see the roll gap; returns are a share of the notional of 1 contract at the RAW entry price.
data._warmup: Every lookback across sessions uses the 20 sessions BEFORE the signal's session; a signal needs 20 earlier sessions.

splits: b3/config/splits_b3.json (exploration 2021-11-16 .. 2024-07-01; validation read ONCE per finalist; final test locked).

execution._rule: Same fill rules as b3/backtest.py: signal on the close of bar t, market order at the open of bar t+1 with the scenario's slippage; stop on the server from bar t+1 on (fills at the stop or the gap open, plus the scenario's slippage and stop extra ticks); time exit at the open of the bar after `hold_min` minutes; flat at the session's flatten time; entries only when the signal bar closes inside the entry window; one position at a time, new entries allowed after an exit; at most 8 entries per session; long and short.
execution.stop_from: signal close: long stop = tick_floor(close x (1 - stop_frac)), short = tick_ceil(close x (1 + stop_frac))
execution._costs: b3/markets.py market('WIN').cost(): base BRL 0.25/side + 1 tick slippage per side, stop +1 tick; conservative BRL 0.50/side + 2 ticks, stop +2 ticks.

families._common: N, M, R are in MINUTES and become bars by dividing by the timeframe. 'cross' = the condition is true on bar t and false on bar t-1 (one signal per crossing). sigma terms are means over the 20 sessions before today, so they are causal. Every family trades both sides.

F01_breakout_follow.rule: long when close_t > max(high of the N minutes before t, same session); short when close_t < min(low of those bars); cross

F03_vwap_z_fade.rule: dev = close/vwap_session - 1; z = dev / sd(dev over all bars of the previous 20 sessions); short on cross z >= k, long on cross z <= -k

F05_shock_fade.rule: R = close_t / close_(t - M) - 1 inside the session; s = mean |R| over the previous 20 sessions; long on cross R <= -k s, short on cross R >= k s

F07_volume_spike_follow.rule: volume_t >= k x median volume of the same minute of day over the previous 20 sessions and close_t != open_t: trade in the bar's direction

F08_volume_spike_fade.rule: F07's condition, against the bar's direction

F09_opening_range_multi.rule: opening range = high/low of the first R minutes; long on every cross of close above the range high, short on every cross below the range low, after the range is complete

F10_day_extreme_reject.rule: bar t-1 set a new session high (high_(t-1) above every earlier high of the session) and close_t < open_t and close_t < close_(t-1): short; symmetric at a new session low: long

F11_rsi_fade.rule: Wilder RSI over 14 bars of the session series (restarts each session); long on cross below lo, short on cross above hi

F12_bollinger_fade.rule: mid = mean of the last 20 closes (same session), band = mid +/- k x sd; short on cross of close above the upper band, long on cross below the lower band

F14_wdo_lead.rule: WDO$N on the same bar times: R_wdo = WDO close_t / close_(t - M) - 1; s = mean |R_wdo| over the previous 20 sessions; dollar up hard -> WIN short on cross R_wdo >= k s; dollar down hard -> WIN long on cross R_wdo <= -k s

F15_day_trend_follow.rule: at bars closing on :00 or :30, r = close / session open - 1; s = mean |r| at the same minute of day over the previous 20 sessions; long if r >= k s, short if r <= -k s

F16_ema_cross_follow.rule: EMAs of the session closes (restart each session) with spans fast/slow in bars; long on cross fast above slow, short on cross below

variants: 46 signal settings x 2 timeframes x 6 exits = 552 variants on exploration (all counted as trials)

gate_search._owner: D2 (a): for THIS program only; the agents' rules keep gates_b3.json and its linear bar (26.6% on 2026-11-16). Search trials are recorded in research/b3/search/ledger.jsonl, not in research/b3/ledger.jsonl.
gate_search._dsr: lab/stats.py deflated_sharpe on the variant's daily net returns (base cost, every exploration session, 0 on days without a trade), n_trials = every variant of the program read so far (A + B), variance of the trial Sharpe ratios across them.
gate_search._pbo: lab/stats.py pbo_cscv(16 slices) over the matrix of daily net returns of ALL variants of the stage; above 0.3 no variant of that stage passes (the selection itself overfits).

path_b.base_selection: from path A: variants with >= 1000 trades a year on exploration, ranked by mean gross return per trade (base); the top 3 from distinct families become the base signals (fixed rule, applied once after A).
path_b.label: the trade's net return in the CONSERVATIVE scenario > 0
features: return over the last 15 and 60 minutes
realized volatility of the last 30 minutes
volume / median volume at the same minute over 20 sessions
distance to the session high and low
WDO return over the last 15 minutes and since its open
path_b.walk_forward: folds = calendar quarters of exploration; each quarter is predicted by a model trained on every base trade that EXITED before the quarter starts; the first 12 months are training only (predictions from 2022-11 on).
path_b._thresholds: trade only base signals with predicted probability >= threshold; 3 thresholds x 3 bases = 9 variants, counted as trials with A's.
path_b.gate: gate_search on the predicted period only (>= 500 trades a year annualized over it).

validation.finalists: every variant of A or B that passes gate_search, at most 5, ranked by deflated Sharpe
validation.read_once: each finalist is read ONCE on validation (B: the model is trained on all exploration base trades and applied unchanged).
validation.pass: net base > 0 and net conservative > 0, >= 500 trades a year, probabilistic Sharpe vs 0 (lab/stats.py) >= 0.9
validation.then: a validation pass becomes a candidate for the Clear demo; nothing goes to real money without the final test, which stays locked.

fidelity: before reading any result, 3 variants run through the official engine (b3/backtest.py) must give the same trades as the fast simulator (>= 99% identical entries and exits) on exploration; trades only, compared by time and price, before any return is looked at.
